name: Forbidden City
heritage: Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
type: palace; museum; building complex; Chinese AAAAA-rated tourist attraction
text: The Forbidden City is the imperial palace complex in the center of the Imperial City in Beijing, China. It was the residence of twenty-four Ming and Qing dynasty Emperors and was the center of political power in China from 1420 to 1924. The palace is now administered by the Palace Museum and has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1987.
